source_title: We Finally Got Past the Guards Blocking the Western Outpost in Phantom Blade Zero - GameRant
source_excerpt:
After reaching the Outpost for the first time in Phantom Blade Zero , following the cutscene with the Blacksmith, players can rest at the Bell and look to their left. Here, they will notice two guards standing near a barricade that blocks the path to the western part of the region.
The guards will refuse to let anyone pass, explaining that the road has been sealed because of the Maskwalkers up ahead. Unfortunately, there is no way around them at this point, and players will need to progress through the main story before returning. This guide explains when the path opens and what you can find beyond the blockade.
This guide contains minor spoilers for events after the third region.
How to Go Past the Guards at the Outpost in Phantom Blade Zero
Image via GameRant | Sources: S-GAME
After the guards deny you access to the western side of the Outpost, continue along the main path and defeat the final boss of the region to unlock the Crimson Forest. This boss drops the Hunter's Chain Sickle , which can be used to access quite a few exploration points.
You will then need to progress through the second region and defeat its final boss to gain access to the third region, the Village of Lu.
Once you reach the Village of Lu, you can use any Bell to travel back to the Outpost. You will find that the situation has changed, as the NPCs around the camp have turned into enemies that you must defeat.
You can also check on the NPCs you encountered during your earlier visits, such as the Old Archer who gives you the bow , but most will either have become hostile or have nothing new to say. Once you have dealt with the enemies and finished checking the area, you can proceed through the path that was previously blocked to access the western side of the Outpost.
Make sure you get the Prayer Beads after defeating the monk NPC on the left.
What to Find on the Western Side of the Outpost
There are several paths to explore in this newly accessible area. One leads to an enemy camp, followed by the Lady's Cave. Inside, you will find a Bell that clears the fog covering the western side of the region, making it easier to explore the area.
The Lady's Cave also contains a key item and an objective for the Four Fierce Axes quest, provided you have already completed the previous objective for that quest. Make sure to explore this area thoroughly so you do not miss anything important.
What Happens If You Return to the Thieves' Camp in Crimson Forest
After reaching the Village of Lu, you should also revisit the Thieves' Camp in the Crimson Forest. The situation here appears to have changed in a similar way to the Outpost, and you will now encounter enemies where you previously found NPCs.
One of these enemies will drop an item that you need to give to an NPC in the Village of Lu. If you want to keep up with these changes and collect additional quest items, it is worth returning to the camp before continuing further into the game.
